title: A signature of immune-related genes correlating with clinical prognosis and immune microenvironment in sepsis.

models.verbatim_formula: risk score = -0.465 x CCL5 + 0.215 x DEFA4 - 1.487 x NFYC + 1.055 x ESR1 - 0.737 x TNFRSF8 - 0.228 x CX3CR1 + 1.003 x SERPINA3
models.expression_scale_used: z-score standardized expression (Methods: EXPgene standardized by Z score); data batch-corrected before modelling
models.reported_performance: GSE65682 training half (n=239): AUC 0.876 (95% CI 0.793-0.946), C-index 0.78; GSE65682 validation half (n=239): AUC 0.855 (0.781-0.932); external E-MTAB-4451 (n=106): AUC 0.815
models.source_location: Methods 'Construction and validation of the IRG signature' + Results paragraph with formula; Table 2 (AIC stepwise)

notes: 478 GSE65682 sepsis patients with survival data split 1:1 randomly. Univariate Cox -> LASSO Cox (20 genes) -> multivariable Cox with stepwise AIC (7 genes). Coefficients from multivariable Cox as printed in Results text. Paper calls GSE65682 'RNA-seq' (it is an array dataset) and mentions batch correction with PCA; supplementary Fig S2 caption misprints NFYC as 'NFY4'. Supplementary Table S4 (xlsx, not downloaded) also lists the 7 genes.
